notes: ONE DEFINITION PER TEST FOR EVERY DECISION, AND YOUR OWN SIP FIGURE. Found with the user's data: the car decision and the new SIP decision disagreed at Balanced for the same plan. Cause: two definitions. Cover: the car counted Savings plus investments marked liquid (Bonds, Stocks: Rs 2.45L), the SIP decision Savings only. Money left over: the SIP decision subtracted all SIPs, the car test did not, although its own explanation says 'after investments'. FIX: _dcLeftOverAt (surplus, lumps added back, minus ALL SIPs) and _dcLiquidSeries (Savings chain plus investments marked liquid) are now the only definitions, used by car, house, land and SIP decisions. A SIP into an investment not marked liquid (Mutual Funds) moves cash out of cover, so the cover test still limits it. EFFECT: purchase decisions' 'money left over' and 'EMI vs spare cash' are now measured after SIPs, so they are slightly stricter. The SIP decision now counts liquid investments as cover, so it is less strict than v2026.11.23.01. NEW: Invest-more questions take an optional 'Your own SIP to check'. The page shows, for each risk level, whether that figure works and what binds (test, month, margin) beside the calculated maximum, with a button to make it a switched-off Change my plan scenario. NEW: when even Rs 0 fails, the page names the month and cause and says the SIP is not the cause, then gives the earliest start in the next 24 months that works and its maximum. 'If you start later' now steps month by month for 12 months, then yearly to year 4 (16 rows). The rules and footnote name which investments count as cover. VERIFIED in headless Chromium on a plan shaped like the user's (Savings Rs 3.87L, Bonds and Stocks liquid, MF Rs 33,500 not liquid, Rs 18L car 50% down Apr 2027, child Jul 2027, parent money Oct 2027). For the same plan, both decisions see identical cover and money left over in every month of the window. The car test now subtracts SIPs. Each maximum is exact (passes at max, fails at +Rs 500). No contradiction: where the car passes with the SIP running, the SIP page never says no room. Own-figure verdicts match the engine at every risk level. The Rs 0-fails message names the cause and the earliest working start, and the month before it fails. All earlier suites pass; engine with no scenarios identical to v2026.05.13.03; no page errors. NOT VERIFIED: the user's real numbers (expected to change: Balanced now counts Bonds and Stocks); Safari; a real Firebase save. The guards sheetVsDash, decisionUsesChain, instrumentCrossPageMismatch and accountDeltaMismatches are not in the HTML file and were not run. NOT BUILT: closed-EMI zero row; settlement on its own line; Edit balances port and Instruments page deletion; Decisions/Scenarios merge.
